stem.text: Yeast contains the enzyme catalase which catalyses the breakdown of hydrogen peroxide ($\text{H}_2\text{O}_2$) as shown.
Yeast was added to a solution of hydrogen peroxide and the total volume of oxygen released was recorded every 30 seconds for 2 minutes. All other variables were standardised.
The data is shown in the table.
What explains the pattern of the data?

A.text: The rate of reaction increases as more enzyme–substrate complexes are formed.

B.text: The rate of reaction increases as the enzyme reaches its maximum velocity ($V_\text{max}$).

C.text: The volume of oxygen released decreases as the enzymes begin to denature.

D.text: The volume of oxygen released decreases as more substrate is converted into product.
